title: Score the Algebra, Not the Span: Dimension Reduction for Transfer Operator Models of Dynamical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.18918v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dimension reduction for dynamical systems is standard practice, and the standard route is spectral: model the transfer (Koopman) operator by its leading modes. We show that on systems assembled from several weakly interacting components --- a structure common in physical and biological settings --- this may either require an exponential number of modes, or drop an entire component: the component is absent from the model rather than modeled coarsely, and no function of it can be predicted at any accuracy. We call this linear masking.   The cause is that a rank-based model pays one coordinate per mode. We propose to score instead the $\sigma$-algebra the coordinates generate, so that products and powers come free and a component's cost is governed only by its generators rather than by all its interactions. The criterion is a $\chi^2$-divergence between the embedded present and future, and it carries a budget guarantee: twice the intrinsic

translated_title: 评分数代数，而非跨度：动力系统传输算子模型的维度缩减
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18918v1 公告类型：新 摘要：动力系统的维度缩减是标准实践，标准途径是谱方法：通过其主要模态来建模传输（库普曼）算子。我们表明，在由几个弱相互作用组件组成的系统上——这种结构在物理和生物环境中常见——这种方法要么需要指数数量的模态，要么会完全丢弃某个组件：该组件在模型中缺失而非被粗略建模，且其任何函数都无法以任何精度预测。我们称之为线性遮蔽。原因是基于秩的模型每个模态支付一个坐标。我们提议改为评分坐标生成的σ-代数，使得乘积和幂次免费，组件的成本仅由其生成元决定，而非所有相互作用。该准则是嵌入的现在与未来之间的χ²散度，并带有预算保证：两倍于内在维度。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于σ-代数评分的维度缩减方法，替代传统的模态谱方法，以避免弱交互系统中组件的完全丢失，并确保预算受内在维度约束。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dimension reduction method based on scoring the σ-algebra generated by coordinates, replacing traditional spectral modal approaches to prevent complete loss of components in weakly interacting systems, with a budget guarantee tied to intrinsic dimension.
